workspace.text:
Hi Brad, I've checked Priya Raman and Marcus Hale's calendars. Here are the overlapping free times for a 30-minute meeting:
- Monday 09:00-10:00
- Tuesday 13:00-14:00
- Tuesday 16:30-17:00
- Wednesday 15:00-16:00
- Friday 11:00-12:00

Please check Elena Soto and David Okafor's calendars against these slots and let me know which ones work for all four partners.

workspace.author: Brad
workspace.text:
I've checked Elena Soto and David Okafor's calendars against all five proposed slots. Unfortunately, none of them work:

- Monday 09:00-10:00: Elena busy 09:00-10:00, David busy 09:00-10:00
- Tuesday 13:00-14:00: Elena busy 13:00-14:00, David busy 13:00-14:00
- Tuesday 16:30-17:00: Elena busy (Hiring panel), David busy (Travel)
- Wednesday 15:00-16:00: Elena free 15:00-15:30 but busy 15:30-16:00; David busy entire 15:00-16:00
- Friday 11:00-12:00: Elena busy 11:00-12:00, David busy 11:00-12:00

None of the slots where Priya and Marcus are both free align with Elena and David's availability. There appears to be no time next week when all four partners can meet.
